import re

thread_ids_all = inbox_ids + archived_ids + spam_ids
thread_ids_all = list(dict.fromkeys(thread_ids_all))

# Refined extraction regexes for Amazon promo codes; require alnum/hyphen and at least one digit
code_patterns = [
    re.compile(r'(?:(?:promo|discount|coupon)\s*code)\s*[:\-]?\s*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\-]{3,40})', re.I),
    re.compile(r'(?:redeem\s*(?:this\s*)?code)\s*[:\-]?\s*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\-]{3,40})', re.I),
    re.compile(r'(?:use\s*(?:the\s*)?code)\s*[:\-]?\s*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\-]{3,40})', re.I),
    re.compile(r'(?:enter\s*code)\s*[:\-]?\s*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\-]{3,40})', re.I),
    # Generic 'code' after 'Amazon' context: token nearby 'promo/coupon/discount'
    re.compile(r'(?:promo|discount|coupon)[^A-Z0-9]{0,30}([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9\-]{3,40})', re.I),
]

amazon_context_pat = re.compile(r'\bamazon\b', re.I)
trigger_words = ['promo', 'discount', 'coupon', 'redeem']

codes_set = {}  # upper -> original

matched_threads = []

for i, tid in enumerate(thread_ids_all):
    # Quick skim without fetching thread: cannot. We must fetch thread to get body.
    thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    texts = []
    for em in thread.get('emails', []) or []:
        body = em.get('body')
        if body:
            texts.append(body)
    for dr in thread.get('drafts', []) or []:
        body = dr.get('body')
        if body:
            texts.append(body)
    if not texts:
        continue
    joined = '\n'.join(texts)

    if not amazon_context_pat.search(joined):
        continue

    if not any(w in joined.lower() for w in trigger_words):
        continue

    found_here = []
    for pat in code_patterns:
        for m in pat.findall(joined):
            token = m.strip()
            # normalize trailing punctuation
            token = re.sub(r'[^A-Z0-9\-]+$', '', token, flags=re.I)
            if not token:
                continue
            # must contain at least one digit
            if not re.search(r'\d', token):
                continue
            if len(token) < 5:
                continue
            cu = token.upper()
            if cu not in codes_set:
                codes_set[cu] = token
            found_here.append(cu)

    if found_here:
        matched_threads.append((tid, sorted(set(found_here))))
    if (i+1) % 50 == 0:
        print('progress', i+1, '/', len(thread_ids_all), 'codes', len(codes_set), 'threads_with_codes', len(matched_threads))

print('total_codes', len(codes_set))
print('codes', list(sorted(codes_set.keys())))
print('matched_threads_count', len(matched_threads))
print('first_5_matched_threads', matched_threads[:5])

import re, math, sys, itertools

# Keywords to identify likely promo-code emails in thread metadata
meta_keywords = ['promo', 'coupon', 'discount', 'redeem', 'offer', 'voucher', 'deal', 'savings', 'save', 'code']
meta_keyword_re = re.compile(r'\b(' + '|'.join(map(re.escape, meta_keywords)) + r')\b', re.I)

def fetch_thread_meta(category, query='Amazon', page_limit=20):
    all_threads=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        if category=='inbox':
            resp=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        elif category=='archived':
            resp=apis.gmail.show_archived_threads(access_token=gmail_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        elif category=='spam':
            resp=apis.gmail.show_spam_threads(access_token=gmail_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        else:
            raise ValueError('bad category')
        threads=resp.get('threads') if isinstance(resp,dict) else None
        if threads is None:
            for k in ['email_threads','results','items','threads','data']:
                if isinstance(resp,dict) and k in resp:
                    threads=resp[k]
                    break
        if not threads:
            break
        all_threads.extend(threads)
        print(category,'page',page_index,'threads',len(threads))
        page_index+=1
    # dedupe by id
    seen=set(); out=[]
    for t in all_threads:
        tid=t.get('email_thread_id')
        if tid not in seen:
            seen.add(tid); out.append(t)
    return out

print('Fetching metadata...')
inbox_meta = fetch_thread_meta('inbox')
arch_meta = fetch_thread_meta('archived')
spam_meta = fetch_thread_meta('spam')

print('meta counts', {'inbox':len(inbox_meta),'archived':len(arch_meta),'spam':len(spam_meta),'total':len(inbox_meta)+len(arch_meta)+len(spam_meta)})

# Filter by keywords in subject/preview

def filter_meta(meta_list):
    out=[]
    for t in meta_list:
        subject=t.get('subject','') or ''
        preview=t.get('preview','') or ''
        label=t.get('label','') or ''
        text=' '.join([subject,preview,label])
        if meta_keyword_re.search(text):
            out.append(t)
    return out

inbox_cand = filter_meta(inbox_meta)
arch_cand = filter_meta(arch_meta)
spam_cand = filter_meta(spam_meta)

print('candidate_meta_counts', {'inbox':len(inbox_cand),'archived':len(arch_cand),'spam':len(spam_cand),'total':len(inbox_cand)+len(arch_cand)+len(spam_cand)})

cand_ids = list(dict.fromkeys([t['email_thread_id'] for t in (inbox_cand+arch_cand+spam_cand)]))
print('cand_ids_sample', cand_ids[:30])
